title: [BETA]: PACK UNKNOWN
description: A mysterious, theme-less texture pack with unique custom items and unpredictable style. As you seen the [BETA] tag, it's work is in progress.
body:
![LOGO](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebadc58ab582c5f70a30e4b1a9897571f915c4fa.png)


 
 
Step into PACK UNKNOWN, the texture pack that refuses to play by the rules. Every favourable item, tool, pixel has been reimagined to give your survival or aesthetic world a fresh, unpredictable vibe.

### **Features (BETA.1):**


**⚔ Custom Tools & Weapons** – Swords, axes and more get insane new designs.

**🌑 Dark Mode GUI** – Sleek, clean interface that’s easy on the eyes.

**✨ Unique Item Textures** – Totems, Golden Apples, Ender Pearls, and more now look extraordinary.

**⚡ Optimized for Performance** – 16×16 resolution keeps FPS smooth with zero lag.

### **Work In Progress:**
This pack is still evolving. Every texture is handcrafted, and your feedback shapes the final masterpiece. Found a bug? Got a wild idea? Comment and help PACK UNKNOWN reach its full potential.

### **Compatibility:** 
Minecraft 1.21.11 (currently).
